verdict.rationale: Vue's docs describe a rich ecosystem and name third-party UI frameworks: Ionic Vue for mobile, and Quasar for desktop and mobile from the same codebase. A hands-on user also praises Vuetify, Vue's Material Design component set. One commenter finds Vue's options weaker than React's Material UI, and another says third-party component design varies wildly; these concern quality, not whether the ecosystem exists. missing for 10: no first-party catalog or directory of UI component libraries, little independent evidence of the ecosystem's breadth, and the reported uneven consistency and quality of third-party components.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pick from a rich ecosystem of third-party pre-built UI component libraries for the framework

citations.quote: A rich, incrementally adoptable ecosystem that scales between a library and a full-featured framework.
Build mobile apps with Ionic Vue; Build desktop and mobile apps from the same codebase with Quasar or Tauri
Vuetify, Vue's material design component set, is 'way better built' than Angular's material component set, based on using both.
